## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5

This stable release promotes the tested 0.3.5 beta series without changing the beta14 runtime behavior.

> **Requires Navimower integration 0.4.3 or newer.**

### Highlights
- Use Navimower's integration-owned Map API and backend-prepared current-cycle rendering for faster, more consistent completed mowing-area display.
- Add persistent **Custom Area** rendering and Visual Editor controls, including legend support that follows the map visibility toggles.
- Add the **Navimower Schedule** view with Home Assistant-native time controls, Custom order editing, queue reordering/repeating/removal, and an On/Off control for the integration-owned scheduler.
- Add the configurable **Settings** dialog with native Home Assistant entity controls behind the card's gear button.
- Improve scheduler discovery, device-scoped entity discovery, mobile dialog behavior, editor organization, visibility controls and card update performance.
- Keep mower/map visibility and history/current-cycle rendering separated so completed cycle data can remain visible without browser-side swath reconstruction.
- Keep map element styling and sizing predictable with the current full-width / automatic-height grid defaults and configurable visual settings.

### Final UI polish
- Settings and Navimower Schedule dialogs close when the dimmed backdrop itself is clicked, matching Notifications behavior.
- The Navimower Schedule close button is aligned to the true top-right even when the scheduler state is shown below the title.
- Clicking inside a dialog does not close it accidentally.

### Compatibility
- Designed to be released together with **Navimower 0.4.3**.
- Existing card configuration remains compatible; the new integration version provides the backend map/scheduler metadata used by this release.
